# Simple Invoicing Guide

> User guide for Simple Invoicing: free, open-source (MIT) GST billing, invoicing and accounting software for Indian small businesses. Use the hosted app free at https://app.gstbill.in, or self-host it from GitHub.

Simple Invoicing makes GST invoices, quotations and proforma invoices, credit and debit notes, delivery challans and e-way bill JSON files. It prints A4, A5 and 80/58 mm thermal rolls, exports the GSTR-1 JSON file for the GST portal (it does not file returns for you), and keeps stock, party ledgers, a day book and cash and bank. It has a built-in MCP server so AI assistants can read and work with your books.
